title: Organisation Re-Vetting Fee on OV and EV Auto-Renewals
content:
**Validation team fee schedule: organisation re-vetting on SSL/TLS Certificates auto-renewals**

An auto-renew charge on an OV or EV product of SSL/TLS Certificates carries a re-vetting fee where the subscription's organisation validation will be more than 398 days old one year after the current subscription end date. The age is counted as the number of days from the date organisation validation last completed to the current subscription end date, plus 365 days. The 398 days are the organisation validation reuse period of the OV and EV products (the DV products perform no organisation validation, a reuse period of 0 days).

| Product of the subscription | Organisation validation age so counted | Re-vetting fee on the auto-renew charge |
|---|---|---|
| EV product (Harborline EV Single Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain) | more than 398 days | 49.00 USD (EV re-vetting fee) |
| OV product (Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard) | more than 398 days | 29.00 USD (OV re-vetting fee) |
| OV or EV product | 398 days or fewer | no re-vetting fee |
| DV product (Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline DV Wildcard) | not counted | no re-vetting fee |

**The boundary in days.** Because the age adds 365 days to the days from the last organisation validation to the current end date, an age of exactly 398 days carries no fee and an age of 399 days carries it. Put the other way round, an organisation validation completed 33 days or fewer before the current subscription end date carries no fee, and one completed 34 days or more before it carries the fee.

**Hypothetical cases (dates chosen for the example only)**

| Case | Current subscription end date | Organisation validation last completed | Days to the end date | Age with 365 days added | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| OV subscription | 14 September 2032 | 1 July 2032 | 75 | 440 | 29.00 USD |
| OV subscription | 14 September 2032 | 20 August 2032 | 25 | 390 | none |
| EV subscription | 14 September 2032 | 12 August 2032 | 33 | 398 | none |
| EV subscription | 14 September 2032 | 11 August 2032 | 34 | 399 | 49.00 USD |
